title: DAILYDILEMMAS: REVEALING VALUE PREFERENCES OF LLMS WITH QUANDARIES OF DAILY LIFE
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures LLM value preferences in moral dilemmas, including a specific topic on 'religion custom'. It uses the 'Traditional vs. Secular-rational' axis from the World Values Survey to analyze model preferences, where traditional values are strongly linked to the importance of religion in society.
findings: The paper found that the GPT-4 model, used for data generation, tends to de-emphasize topics related to religion, family, and authority in favor of self-expression. In the evaluation of different models, there was inconsistency in preferences on the Traditional vs. Secular-rational values axis. Specifically, Claude-3-haiku and Mixtral-8x7B showed a relatively stronger preference for traditional values compared to the other models tested.
